CustomField.description: Only set on a "Provider callout" step - the exact JSON body of that callout, already pseudonymised, since it's built from the same masked values sent to the provider.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Left blank for a data source step. Only captured for a user with AIUserSettings__c.ShouldCaptureExecutionSteps__c and DebugModeEnabled__c both on, to avoid the storage cost otherwise.
CustomField.label: Request JSON
